title: Harden the shared ResolvedPolyline finite-length contract
description: Council seven-seat audit found the shared ResolvedPolyline primitive accepted non-finite source positions and could overflow its float TotalLength even though downstream skeleton/IK consumers require finite resolved geometry. Because both ResolvedBody and ResolvedLimb delegate to this utility, the fix belongs in one shared boundary rather than duplicated in each resolver. Reject non-finite positions/segment lengths and total-length overflow and cover the shared behavior with focused runtime regressions.

comments.author: council-seven-seat-audit
comments.body: Implemented in ResolvedPolyline: finite position validation, finite segment-length validation, and explicit total-length overflow rejection. Added ResolvedBodyTests regressions covering non-finite polyline position and total-length overflow. No Unity/runtime execution was performed in this campaign.
